title: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (BC29.1): Data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric (No APIs or OData Needed)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 2 introduces data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric, allowing users to synchronize selected companies and tables to OneLake without needing APIs or OData. The feature enables direct analytics, reporting, and data integration with Fabric IQ, Power BI, and Data Factory.
key_points: Data mirroring replicates Business Central data to an open mirrored database in Microsoft Fabric's OneLake in Delta Parquet format
Users can select specific companies and tables to synchronize, with continuous exports of ongoing changes
Authentication requires either a custom app registration or the Microsoft Business Central Fabric Export application with proper service principal setup
Workspace access and permissions must be configured through Microsoft Entra ID and Fabric workspace management
Synchronization status and progress are monitored through the Export Summary and Fabric Synchronization Overview pages
features: Microsoft Business Central Fabric Export application

quotes.text: Connect Business Central to Microsoft Fabric to make business data available for analytics, reporting, and data integration.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core business value and purpose of the data mirroring feature

quotes.text: Business Central then replicates an initial snapshot and ongoing changes into OneLake.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes how the mirroring mechanism works to keep Fabric data current
